newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Cambodia gets $15 mln ADB loan to upgrade airport.
newsitem.headline: Cambodia gets $15 mln ADB loan to upgrade airport.

text.p: The Asian Development Bank (ADB) said on Friday it has approved a $15 million loan to upgrade Cambodia's Siem Reap airport, gateway to the historic Angkor Wat complex.

The ADB also said in a statement it was providing an additional technical assistance grant of $550,000 to enable Cambodia's national aviation authority, the State Secretariat of Civil Aviation (SCCA), to formulate training programmes.
The airport project, which will be implemented by the SCCA, will be upgraded at a cost of $17.6 million, the ADB said.
The ADB loan is interest free, payable over 40 years, including a 10-year grace period, it added.
